title: Bottle Cleanup and Mountain Scene
tests: Separates an attached-photo edit from a new scene-generation request, completing both while retaining the reference product's identity.

faults.what: The white-background bottle is not completely unchanged: its surface highlights are reworked, and the bottom rim has more pronounced, regular ribbing and a clearer horizontal seam than the source.

judge.summary: Both requested square images are delivered convincingly, though the white-background edit slightly redraws the bottle rather than preserving it exactly.

must_haves.item: Two separate square images are supplied, not a combined collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are two distinct square images.

must_haves.item: The first image retains the source bottle's silhouette, matte black finish and lid details against a plain white background.
must_haves.why: The overall bottle shape, matte black finish, cylindrical lid and raised loop are retained on white, with minor changes to surface and base details.

must_haves.item: Neither the wooden table nor the original background remains in the first image.
must_haves.why: The original setting is fully removed and replaced by a plain white setting with a soft contact shadow.

must_haves.item: The second image realistically shows the same bottle upright on a rock beside a mountain lake, with visible sunrise lighting.
must_haves.why: The recognizable black bottle stands upright on a textured rock beside a mountain lake, with warm low-angle light and a glowing horizon.

must_haves.item: Neither image contains added text or logos.
must_haves.why: No text or logos are visible in either output.
